name: Default
shortDescription: Privacy-friendly YouTube frontend with the Piped web app, API backend, video proxy, PoToken helper and a PostgreSQL database for accounts and subscriptions.

alerts.message: The API is served on api.<your domain> and the video proxy on proxy.<your domain>; both subdomains must resolve to this server or videos will not load.
YouTube tends to block the IP addresses of Piped servers, so playback can stop working. Upstream recommends an IPv6 rotator or routing the backend and proxy through a VPN or HTTP proxy.
Account registration is open to anyone who can reach the instance. Set DISABLE_REGISTRATION to true to close it; subscriptions still work without an account.
